description: This file defines the A2UIHandler class which manages interactions with the A2UI component in an Android environment, including URL resolution, message decoding, and communication via JavaScript execution within a WebView or similar component.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Handles communication and message processing for the A2UI component, including URL resolution, readiness checks, and message decoding.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted for Canvas actions based on predefined trusted URLs.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the host URL for the A2UI component based on provided URL fetchers.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI is ready by evaluating JavaScript and waiting until it reports readiness.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes and validates messages received from the A2UI, parsing JSON and enforcing message structure.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates that the A2UI message conforms to version 0.8 specifications.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to apply messages to the A2UI via a global object.
